attacks.name: Spider Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!critical| |!wild| |*Momentum|: After this attack is resolved, choose another enemy character within |!range| 2 of the defender. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character. The chosen character suffers a collision as if this character were Thrown into them.

attacks.name: Whatever a Spider Can
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.

|!wild| |*Catch!|: After this attack is resolved, you may choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2 or less within |!range| 3 of this character and destroy it. The defender suffers a collision as if the terrain feature were Thrown into it.

superPowers.name: Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Team (Affiliation: Web Warriors)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, during an allied character's Activation, it may spend 1 |!power| and choose an enemy character within |!range| 2. The chosen character gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition. If the chosen character already had the Slow special condition, Place it within |!range| 1 of its current position and remove the Slow special condition.

superPowers.name: Web Swing
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. The next time it makes a |*Spider Strike| this turn, add two dice to the attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Witty Banter
superPowers.body: If an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character is attacking an allied character, this character may use this superpower during the |*Modify Opponent’s Dice| step of the attack. You may reroll 1 die in the attack roll.

superPowers.name: Mastered Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least one |!critical|. Additionally, this character may reroll any number of its defense or dodge dice.
